paragraphs.zh: in der die Substituenten und Symbole die folgende Bedeutung haben:
paragraphs.en: in which the substituents and symbols have the following meanings:

paragraphs.zh: R1     ein gegebenenfalls substituierter Kohlenwasserstoff-Rest, der gegebenenfalls zusätzlich ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Heteroatome aus der Gruppe Phosphor, Sauerstoff, Schwefel, Stickstoff, Fluor, Chlor, Brom und Jod enthält;
paragraphs.en: R1     an optionally substituted hydrocarbon radical which optionally additionally contains one or more identical or different heteroatoms from the group consisting of phosphorus, oxygen, sulfur, nitrogen, fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine;
paragraphs.notes: The symbol is printed as R with a superscript 1; transcribed inline as R1.

paragraphs.zh: R2, R3, R4 und R5     unabhängig voneinander Wasserstoff, Hydroxy, Thio, Amino, Cyano, Nitro, Halogen oder einen gegebenenfalls substituierten Kohlenwasserstoff-Rest, der gegebenenfalls zusätzlich ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Heteroatome aus der Gruppe Phosphor, Sauerstoff , Schwefel, Stickstoff, Fluor, Chlor, Brom und Jod enthält;
paragraphs.en: R2, R3, R4 and R5     independently of one another hydrogen, hydroxy, thio, amino, cyano, nitro, halogen or an optionally substituted hydrocarbon radical which optionally additionally contains one or more identical or different heteroatoms from the group consisting of phosphorus, oxygen, sulfur, nitrogen, fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine;
paragraphs.notes: The space before the comma in 'Sauerstoff , Schwefel' is as printed and has been preserved. Superscripts transcribed inline.

paragraphs.zh: R6     OR12, Alkylthio, Halogenalkylthio, Alkenylthio, Halogenalkenylthio, Alkinylthio, Halogenalkinylthio, Alkylsulfinyl, Halogenalkylsulfinyl, Alkenylsulfinyl, Halogenalkenylsulfinyl, Alkinylsulfinyl, Halogenalkinylsulfinyl, Alkylsulfonyl, Halogenalkylsulfonyl, Alkenylsulfonyl, Halogenalkenylsulfonyl, Alkinylsulfonyl, Halogenalkinylsulfonyl, Cyano, Cyanato, Thiocyanato oder Halogen;
paragraphs.en: R6     OR12, alkylthio, haloalkylthio, alkenylthio, haloalkenylthio, alkynylthio, haloalkynylthio, alkylsulfinyl, haloalkylsulfinyl, alkenylsulfinyl, haloalkenylsulfinyl, alkynylsulfinyl, haloalkynylsulfinyl, alkylsulfonyl, haloalkylsulfonyl, alkenylsulfonyl, haloalkenylsulfonyl, alkynylsulfonyl, haloalkynylsulfonyl, cyano, cyanato, thiocyanato or halogen;
paragraphs.notes: OR12 is printed as OR with a superscript 12. German 'Alkinyl' is rendered 'alkynyl' and 'Halogenalkyl' as 'haloalkyl' in the translation.

paragraphs.zh: R7     Wasserstoff, Tetrahydropyranyl-3, Tetrahydropyranyl-4, Tetrahydrothiopyranyl-3, Alkyl, Cycloalkyl, Alkoxy, Alkoxyalkyl, Alkylcarbonyl, Alkoxycarbonyl, Alkylthio, Phenyl, wobei die acht letztgenannten Gruppen
paragraphs.en: R7     hydrogen, tetrahydropyranyl-3, tetrahydropyranyl-4, tetrahydrothiopyranyl-3, alkyl, cycloalkyl, alkoxy, alkoxyalkyl, alkylcarbonyl, alkoxycarbonyl, alkylthio, phenyl, where the eight last-mentioned groups

structures.core: generic Markush formula (I): a 2-aroyl cyclic 1,3-dione / enol drawn as a ring containing Y and Z and a variable bracketed segment ( )v, joined through a C=O bridge to a benzene ring
substituents: left ring: R6 on the ring carbon that carries the drawn C=C, adjacent to the aroyl-bearing carbon
left ring: the exocyclic carbonyl bridge C(=O) on the ring carbon adjacent to the R6 carbon
left ring: a ring =O (ketone) on the ring carbon adjacent to the aroyl-bearing carbon, on the other side
left ring: Y as the ring member next to that ring C=O
left ring: Z as the ring member next to Y
left ring: (R7)w attached to Z, w a variable count
left ring: a bracketed variable segment ( )v spanning the ring edge between Z and the R6-bearing carbon, v a variable count
benzene ring: attachment to the C=O bridge at C1
benzene ring: L-R1 at C3, L drawn as a divalent linker between the ring and R1

drawings.notes: Generic formula, not a specific compound: every position is a variable symbol, and the ring size on the left is variable through the bracketed ( )v segment, so no name and no SMILES can be given. Benzene numbering above is read off the drawing going round from the aroyl attachment towards R2; the drawing itself carries no locant numbers. The left ring is drawn in the enol form, with a C=C between the R6-bearing carbon and the aroyl-bearing carbon and a single ring C=O. The bond from Z to (R7)w is drawn with a short cross-hatch, the usual notation for a variable number of substituents. Labelled (I) below. This is the invention's generic formula in claim 1, not a reaction scheme and not prior art.
